turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. I came in today because... well, the thought of getting on an airplane right now just scares me so bad. I know it doesn't make any sense, but my body just tells me that the plane is going to fall. It's gotten really hard to deal with.

symptom_reasoning.S062: The patient describes an intense, irrational fear of getting on an airplane, which is a specific phobic fear.

turns.doctor_question: Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different things in your life on most days, or is your anxiety primarily focused on the fear of flying?
turns.patient_response: No, it's really just the flying. I mean, I have the normal stress that comes with work and life, but I don't worry about things all the time. It's just... when it comes to airplanes, that's when the panic hits me. It's completely focused on that one thing.

symptom_reasoning.S062: The patient states their fear is completely focused on one specific thing, which is flying/airplanes.
symptom_reasoning.S063: The patient describes that when it comes to airplanes, 'that's when the panic hits me,' indicating an immediate fear response to the phobic stimulus.
symptom_reasoning.S056: The patient explicitly denies worrying about many different things all the time, stating they only experience normal life stress.
